name: dd1-copilot
description: Play Darkest Dungeon 1 through compact observations, verified actions and durable campaign memory.

interface.shortDescription: Play DD1 with verified actions and campaign memory.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to a locally installed DD1 game bridge. Provides compact and delta observations, hero and skill ID actions, verified combat transitions, persistent campaign records and model-authored reviews. Requires Windows, Node.js 24 or newer, an explicitly bound save, and the separately installed compatible game DLL.
defaultPrompt: 查看我的暗黑地牢存档，解释关键决策并继续游戏。
